targets.authors: Du, Hongfei; Yang, Jing; King, Ronnel B.; Yang, Lei; Chi, Peilian
targets.title: COVID-19 Increases Online Emotional and Health-Related Searches
targets.evidence_quote:
The claim selected for replication from Du (2020) is that, in the United States, increasing
COVID-19 prevalence would be associated with a great search volume associated with panic
buying.
targets.outcome_quote:
Results indicate the Panic Buying Index is positively associated with the number of infections,
i.e. the result of the original study was replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Both the alternative-keyword replication and same-keyword fresh-sample analysis support the positive association.

reasoning: Full five-page project report, including original citation, verified by project ID, project URL and Marta Kołczyńska authorship; OSF contributors match assigned project.
